feature: A label grows to fit what it says
summary: A text box now re-measures itself. Make it narrower and the words re-wrap and the box grows down to hold them; give a copy of a component longer wording and it shows all of it; a stack closes up around a label that gained a line, in the same undo step.
setup: Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next. Nothing new to switch on: this is how text boxes behave now. "Groups that arrange their own contents" and "Make a component" need to be on for the last three steps.

try.do: On a blank canvas press T, click, type "Photonz measures what it says", then press Escape to select it.
Drag its right middle handle left until the words wrap onto three lines.
Press Command Z once, then type 180 into W in Position & Size and press Return.
Draw two rectangles under it, rubber-band all three and press Control Command G to stack them.
Type 12 into Gap, then 150 into W, then set Horizontal to Stretch.
Press Option Command K to make it a component, expose its wording knob, and drag a copy out of the Library.
Type a much longer sentence into the copy's Wording field and press Return.

evaluate: When you drag the right edge in, does the box growing downward feel like the box following you, or like it moving on its own?
Is keeping the top edge put the right anchor, or would you rather a paragraph grew about its middle?

A copy given longer wording keeps the wrap width it had and gains lines. For a button label you would probably want it to get WIDER instead. Does the rule "a box you narrowed keeps its width, a box you never narrowed stays on one line" match what you expect without being told it?
Rows below a label that gained a line move down in the same step as the edit. Did anything look like it moved twice?
The H field stays blank for text. Is that clear, or does it read as broken?
rough: Screen Recording was granted, so every shot above is the real window, not an offscreen render.

Typing a tiny number into W is still allowed: type 12 and you get a one-word-per-line sliver. Dragging the same edge stops at about 80. Filed as "A width you type into a text box has a floor, like the one you drag".
The height field shows nothing at all for text rather than showing the number it came out at, dimmed. Filed as "A text box says how tall it turned out".
Stretching a text box up and down now does nothing, because its height is its words. The menu still offers it. Filed as "A text box is not offered a stretch that does nothing".

A box whose height was already wrong stays wrong until you change its width or its words. That is deliberate, so a hand-laid-out document is never quietly re-flowed, but it does mean there is no way to say "just fit this".

Changed away from what was written down: the design doc said resizing a container never re-wraps anything. It does now, for text only, because that was the whole complaint. Text point size still never changes.

A copy of a component now arranges itself the way its original does. It did not before, which was invisible until something inside a copy changed size and left a hole where the row used to end. This was not in the task; it was found by playtesting it.
